story_fits.chapter: 3 (eps 21-30), ep 23 is the COUNTDOWN cliffhanger, Day 3/80
story_fits.scene: Clyde makes a colour-coded '80-DAY GLOW-UP PLAN' poster for the race against the Collector, posts it, and by Day 3 has done only the 'buy new trainers' line. The gold-ring account likes the plan post (pays toward gold_ring_follower and delete_or_bait).
story_fits.lesson: Announcing a plan feels like doing it; the work starts on the boring day.
story_fits.rule_line: PLANS ARE FREE. DAY 3 IS WHERE THEY CHARGE YOU.

story_fits.scene: In Bulawayo a cousin's graduation photos are everywhere; Clyde rents a gown and mortarboard just for a selfie so he doesn't look behind. Solo admits he compares his pages to the Collector's every night.
story_fits.lesson: Comparing your start to someone else's middle only makes you rush.
story_fits.rule_line: HE'S ON PAGE 300. YOU CAN'T FIND PAGE 23.
story_fits.button: Clyde returns the gown late and pays the fine: 'WORTH IT. 40 LIKES.'

story_fits.scene: Clyde's inbox: 'YOU WON A FREE DUBAI TRIP! Just send your passport + the pages.' Signed with a gold-ring emoji. Clyde has already packed. Ties the Collector to the Dubai leg without showing him.
story_fits.lesson: If a deal is too good, you are what's being sold.
story_fits.rule_line: FREE TRIP TO DUBAI. THE PRICE IS YOU.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'IT SAYS FIRST CLASS THOUGH.' (callback to ep 21)
